theorems.name: Submission.any_radius_monotonicity_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ p : ℝ, (n : ℝ) < p → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (δ ρ : ℝ), 0 < δ → δ ≤ (p - n) / (4 * p) → V.AllardHypotheses H p δ ρ → (∀ (y : Amb n ℓ) (R s r : ℝ), 0 < s → s ≤ r → r < R → closedBall y R ⊆ closedBall 0 ρ → (V.weight (closedBall y s)).toReal / s ^ n ≤ Real.exp (2 * (4 * p * δ / (p - n))) * ((V.weight (closedBall y r)).toReal / r ^ n) + 2 * Real.exp (4 * p * δ / (p - n)) * (4 * p * δ / (p - n))) ∧ (∀ y ∈ V.support, ∀ R s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < R → closedBall y R ⊆ closedBall 0 ρ → Real.exp (-(4 * p * δ / (p - n))) * (unitBallVolume n - 4 * p * δ / (p - n)) * s ^ n ≤ (V.weight (closedBall y s)).toReal) ∧ ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Amb n ℓ) ρ, ENNReal.ofReal (‖x - V.tangentProj x x‖ ^ 2 / ‖x‖ ^ (n + 2)) ∂V.weight ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (4 * p * δ / (p - n)) * (Real.exp (4 * p * δ / (p - n)) * (1 + δ) * unitBallVolume n + 4 * p * δ / (p - n) - unitBallVolume n))
